device_identity_source: Each matrix report environment.native_build records the actual Metal device and architecture from mlx.device_info().
compilation_scope: Python/MLX runtime plus existing MLX-compiled Metal kernels. No fresh CUDA build, Linux run, or NVIDIA driver measurement. Existing host/UBSan binaries were rerun separately.
measurement_scope: One serialized cooperating GPU workflow, FP16 rowwise decode, five warmups and three measured trials, two model families, cold/disabled/primed repeated-prefix workloads. Priming outside timing; no hardware utilization/power counters.
